name: Prison 69
source:
You play as Lucas, a boy who was arrested charged with indecent assault for having sex in a club, and while you try to prove to every one why you shouldn't be in the prison, you meet a bunch of hot and naughty prisoners.

[From [url=https://lovemann.itch.io/deep-prison]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演卢卡斯，一个因在俱乐部发生性行为而被指控猥亵罪被捕的男孩，当你试图向每个人证明为什么你不应该进监狱时，你遇到了一群性感而顽皮的囚犯。

[来自[url=https://lovemann.itch.io/deep-prison]Itch.io[/url]]
